ChaosCoveragePlan.role: Noncanonical derived selector/measurement over accepted HostileChaosMatrix; does not replace matrix identity or source authority.
factor_schema: parameter bucket for bounded numeric fault parameters
recovery or failure phase where declared
rules: Measure coverage only on predeclared finite factor domains.
Impossible or forbidden combinations remain explicit constraints, never silently omitted.
t-way coverage is a prioritization/coverage statement, never proof that higher-order interactions do not exist.
Existing all-five-family cases may remain sentinel cases while additional compact cases can target uncovered interactions in a successor planner/consumer.

ChaosSequenceCoverage.role: Separate order-sensitive measurement; simultaneous family presence is not equivalent to sequence coverage.
priority_orders: authority invalidation -> stale operation -> re-observation/rebind -> valid operation
session/service restart -> device rediscovery -> permission revalidation
network disconnect/reset -> stale route use -> route re-observation -> reconnect
process/lifecycle reset -> old-generation request -> current-generation request

ChaosExecutionSnapshot.role: Immutable pre-intervention runtime identity for a later Trigger4/target-twin executor. Snapshot creation itself is not execution.
must_bind: WP1204 source blob SHA or exact consumed source identity
target profile digest and target/twin generation
executor/runtime/host identity permitted by current authority
ChaosExecutionSnapshot.immutability_rule: Once the execution snapshot is sealed, later edits to source, matrix, target profile or stop conditions cannot be attributed to that run.

ChaosStopConditionSet.role: Dynamic runtime abort policy distinct from WP1208 static case/event ceilings.
rules: Fail closed if a mandatory stop signal is stale, wrong-generation or unobservable, according to a predeclared policy.
A stopped/aborted experiment is infrastructure/test evidence, not automatically a product semantic failure.
Do not use the same corrupted observation path as the sole stop guard when the injected fault can invalidate that path.

StaleAuthorityFenceProbe.role: Causal acceptance discriminator for WP1208's existing authority_fence_event_ids and AUTHORITY_REBIND_POLICY.
paired_steps: establish valid pre-fault operation at generation g
apply declared generation-invalidating fault producing g+1
submit an explicitly bound stale-g operation and require rejection/no authority revival
re-observe current state/topology/permission and bind g+1
submit matched valid g+1 operation and require acceptance at its own bounded scope
StaleAuthorityFenceProbe.acceptance_rule: generation advancement alone earns zero fencing credit; stale rejection plus current-generation rescue must both be observed at exact runtime identity.

MatchedChaosRunPair.role: Control-versus-intervention attribution layer analogous to WP800 matched-run provenance but specific to target-twin chaos execution.
MatchedChaosRunPair.rule: Unknown external effect outcome remains UNKNOWN; never blindly replay merely to complete the pair.

selection_algorithm_order: 1. Always retain mandatory invariant sentinels: protected-state fence, stale-authority non-revival, degradation-order/completion fail-closed cases.
2. Prefer cases that add the largest predeclared constrained t-way interaction coverage per event/case cost.
3. Prefer cases that add uncovered order-sensitive t-event sequence coverage.
4. Reduce any discovered violation toward a minimal reproducing fault cut before broadening it.

5. Only if exact executable outcome lineage exists, optionally rank additional candidate fault cuts using LDFI-style backward causal support; otherwise remain with deterministic coverage/negative evidence and do not invent lineage.
6. Preserve broad sentinel/regression cases even if a causal selector predicts they are low-value, so selector-model error cannot erase known safety boundaries.
mapping_to_current_code_without_mutation: FaultEvent.action/domain already supply categorical interaction factors.

FaultEvent.target supplies an exact value but a successor coverage layer should use a predeclared normalized target-class projection to avoid treating every unique resource string as a different coverage dimension.
FaultEvent.offset_ms and sequence permit both concurrency and relative-order projections; current concurrent_offsets_ms is retained as a strong identity feature but is not itself sequence coverage.
generation_before/generation_after and authority_fence_event_ids supply exact anchors for stale-generation probes.

FaultSpec.parameters_json has bounded action-specific numeric fields such as latency_ms, loss_percent, offset_ms and remaining_bytes; coverage must use preregistered buckets rather than unbounded raw numeric Cartesian products.
HostileChaosMatrix.sha256 can be the canonical input identity for a derived coverage plan, so no second matrix truth store is needed.

The current MAX_* ceilings remain static resource guards; dynamic runtime stop conditions belong in the later executor snapshot/receipt rather than retroactively changing accepted source-level semantics.
candidate_acceptance_metrics_for_later_t: constrained t-way interaction coverage before and after each selected case
order-tuple coverage before and after each selected case
cases/events executed per unique coverage increment
invariant violations found per case/event budget
time or event count to first violation
stale-generation attempts rejected / stale-generation attempts submitted
current-generation rescue successes after valid rebind

falsification_matrix.hypothesis: Coverage-guided selection is more informative than the current broad all-five-family-only selection at equal case/event budget.
falsification_matrix.counterhypothesis: The current compact matrix already covers the relevant interactions; the coverage layer adds bookkeeping without new failures or meaningful compression.
falsification_matrix.test: At a fixed case/event budget, compare unique constrained t-way + sequence coverage, unique violations and minimal counterexample size for current ordering versus coverage-prioritized ordering on the same immutable candidate pool.

falsification_matrix.hypothesis: Order-sensitive coverage finds bugs that same-offset concurrency coverage misses.
falsification_matrix.counterhypothesis: For the target-twin implementation, the relevant recovery semantics are order-insensitive once generation fencing is correct.
falsification_matrix.test: Use matched fault sets with different declared orders around invalidation/recovery; require any behavior delta to bind exact sequence identity.

falsification_matrix.hypothesis: Lineage-guided minimal cuts reduce executions once a sound typed outcome lineage exists.
falsification_matrix.counterhypothesis: The available lineage is incomplete/correlated and causes the selector to miss real failures; covering designs are safer and equally efficient.
falsification_matrix.test: Preregister the bounded lineage model, compare predicted cuts against covering-array sentinels, and reject lineage promotion if it loses known counterexamples or fails to reduce execution cost.

falsification_matrix.hypothesis: Generation fencing prevents stale-authority revival after hostile lifecycle/session/network/permission faults.
falsification_matrix.counterhypothesis: The planner advances generation metadata, but a real consumer can still accept an operation bound to the old generation.
falsification_matrix.test: Execute the explicit stale-g rejection + g+1 re-observe/rebind/rescue sequence and require both halves; metadata-only advancement is insufficient.

falsification_matrix.hypothesis: Dynamic stop conditions safely bound hostile experiments.
falsification_matrix.counterhypothesis: The injected fault can blind or stale the stop signal, creating false safety.
falsification_matrix.test: Fault the primary observation channel in a bounded twin and verify the predeclared independent/degraded stop policy activates or fails closed.

resource_efficiency_implications.expected_benefit: Reduce redundant hostile cases and later target-twin executions while increasing explicit interaction/order coverage and attribution quality.
resource_efficiency_implications.expected_overhead: Deterministic combinatorial bookkeeping and coverage-set storage; no model call is required for the baseline selector.
resource_efficiency_implications.preferred_baseline: A small deterministic constrained covering/greedy coverage selector before any model- or lineage-heavy mechanism.
resource_efficiency_implications.anti_overbuild: Do not import a general chaos framework or Molly/LDFI runtime into F2 merely because the research mechanism is useful; distill the minimal typed selection, provenance and falsifier structures.

handoff.to: Trigger4 later executable target-twin consumer / successor workpackage
recommended_order: derive finite factor/constraint schema from accepted fault primitives
build deterministic coverage/sequence measurement over immutable matrix/candidate pool
bind immutable execution snapshot and matched control/intervention identity
execute stale-generation rejection + current-generation rescue probe
measure equal-budget current-vs-coverage-guided selection before adding optional lineage prioritization

next_research_gate: E3 only if a distinct source-level or executable claim can be reproduced without duplicating an active Trigger6 objective. Strongest candidate is a deterministic equal-budget counterexample showing CASE_COUNT/all-five-family coverage can miss a predeclared pairwise/sequence interaction, but acquire a new atomic E3 claim and re-enter current F2 state first.
